decision.summary: A single sustained multi-axis displacement begins abruptly at index 605 and persists without recovery through the end of the allowed context (729). All axes (N, E, U) exhibit coherent, large-magnitude shifts consistent with a permanent step or large-scale motion; however, absence of an opposing return prevents confirmation of a temporary offset. No other candidate temporary intervals meet criteria within allowed context.

intervals.observation: N/E/U all show abrupt, multi-sample upward shift beginning at index 605 (e.g., N jumps from ~1.6 to >8, E from ~5 to >9, U drops sharply from ~-2.7 to <-18), forming a sustained platform with no opposing return observed through end of allowed context (index 729). Onset spans indices 605–606; interior shows variability but remains offset relative to pre-605 baseline. Return not observed → status uncertain.
